Class CabinTile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.tiles.Tile
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.tiles.CabinTile
Direct Known Subclasses:
StartingCabinTile
public class CabinTile extends Tile
Represents a cabin tile that can host human crew or specific types of aliens.

By default, cabins contain a CrewType.DOUBLE_HUMAN crew. Depending on the configuration, they may be able to host alien crew types (Brown or Purple aliens). The tile tracks both its current crew and its ability to host each alien type.

      public void allowAlienType(CrewType alienType, boolean alienHabitable)
      Updates this cabin's ability to host a specific alien type. If the cabin already contains an alien of that type, and it's disallowed, the crew is removed.
      Parameters:
      alienType - the alien type
      alienHabitable - whether this cabin can now host that alien type
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the given type is not an alien
